caseName: Ward M. Miller v. Robert A. Haines, Director, Etc.
caseNameFull: MILLER v. HAINES, DIRECTOR, DEPARTMENT OF MENTAL HYGIENE AND CORRECTION OF OHIO, Et Al.
attorneys: Freeman T. Eagleson, Jr., for appellant., William B. Saxbe, Attorney General of Ohio, Winifred A. Dunton, Assistant Attorney General, and Charles S. Lopeman for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas

is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
